Files FPSM writes into its working directory

fps_output_files.Rd

FPSM creates these three under fixed names in the current working directory, which is why each run needs a directory of its own.

Usage

fps_output_files()

Value

Character vector of file names.

See also

Other FPSM helpers: fps_pools(), fps_run_docker(), fps_stocks_by_pool(), open_fps_raw_out_dataset(), read_fps_raw_out(), write_fps_raw_out_parquet()
